headline: A 2018 law renamed the Brighton, Colorado post office at 90 North 4th Avenue after Detective Heath McDonald Gumm.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service facility in Brighton, Colorado a new official name, the Detective Heath McDonald Gumm Post Office. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates. The summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the renaming took effect on that date.
